comments.author: Blake.C
comments.body:
If you look at the very bottom of ivyro, there IS a contact email:

storycraft0@gmail.com

I have sent an e-mail to them long ago, but never did get a response back. Either they no longer use that email address, or I misread the 0 after craft as an upper-case O and not the number 0. Perhaps someone else can have better luck?

In anycase, Ive urged everyone to be prepared and keep other UWO sites in check (such as the UWO wiki) in the event Ivyro really does shut down, which now im afraid is starting to be a reality if what Guilder says proves to be correct.
